fields.notes: PCI Express 5.0 is a protocol spec; it does not impose PDK-specific SDC / floorplan constraints. The Base Spec specifies 32 GT/s NRZ eye masks, the four-phase enhanced equalization procedure, the up-to-two-retimer channel model, and mandatory Lane Margining. SoC integration constraints (clock-tree budget, PHY characterization, retimer placement) live in the SoC integration spec.

pcb_constraints.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential
pcb_constraints.ESD_protection_class: HBM 2 kV minimum (Class 2); diodes placed close to connector

pad_constraints.shared_HS_LP_pad: Same Dp/Dn pair carries both modes; lane-state controller arbitrates

sdc_floorplan_hints.Clock_Lane_PLL_placement: Close to source pads; minimize jitter.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Per_lane_delay_line_placement: Close to receiver pads; programmable for deskew.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Sync_hunter_placement: Receiver-side; pipelined to meet Clock-Lane DDR rate.

electrical_channel_constraints.equalization: Four-phase enhanced TX equalization (Phase 0-3) with preset hints P0-P10; receiver CTLE + DFE.
electrical_channel_constraints.lane_margining: Mandatory Lane Margining at the Receiver.
electrical_channel_constraints.channel_loss_note: 32 GT/s is loss-limited; long channels typically require one or two retimers.

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
